summary: Po Mo Knock Knock is a 1999 experimental comedy short film written by David Ball and directed by Greg Pak, performed by Ball and other members of the New York City improv troupe The Pollyannas, including Bill Stiles and Vin Knight. The title refers to its subject, postmodern knock knock jokes. The film parodies postmodernism and postmodern experimental film through irony, internal contradictions, references to Jacques Derrida, and Godardian title cards.
one_line: A 1999 experimental comedy short by David Ball and Greg Pak that parodies postmodernism through postmodern knock knock jokes.
